name: sendgrid
title: Twilio SendGrid
summary: Mail Send (202, empty body), transactional templates, bounce suppressions and global stats, with Event Webhook batches and invalid-recipient, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: The official spec is split into 46 per-product OpenAPI 3.1 files (spec/json/tsg_*_v3.json), so there is no single file for --full to swap in. This example covers tsg_mail_v3.json (sha256 1bf9b256780b4c32a48e054eb9a8f93c03b586f9586d12b0ebbcdde9c170fac3), tsg_templates_v3.json (d38d9f0cd014ea2d2ac12738f155e969a8f81ca03d85bbcaa959048c15b05a3c), tsg_suppressions_v3.json (3d851d7bfbb9a6d446971ff114cf19e93caec246fed26532000915aae9cdf02f) and tsg_stats_v3.json (d5076d2c898c89e92b9f92ca5c154ff3b7472dd184c7d6ea307ed2551892f7d6) at this commit.
